title: Dental Check-Up Camp at Zundal Primary School
excerpt: In collaboration with Arsh Dental Clinic, Megh Foundation delivered oral health check-ups and hygiene education for 300+ children.

bodyMarkdown:
## Preventive health at school level

Megh Foundation, with Arsh Dental Clinic, organized a dental camp at Zundal Primary School to provide early screening and oral hygiene education for children.

## What was delivered

- Comprehensive dental check-ups
- Basic issue identification and referrals
- Brushing technique demonstrations
- Child-friendly hygiene awareness

## Why it matters

School-based preventive health interventions reduce long-term risk and improve learning outcomes by keeping children healthier and more confident.
